about: A1 content pack: institutional activities (events). Each event is taken from a primary source: an NCPOR news item, a PIB release, or a description on NCPOR's official YouTube channel. Summaries are short paraphrases of that source, not quotes. Where a fact comes from somewhere else, the 'verify' field says so. title_hi is filled only where the source itself is in Hindi; the AI pipeline drafts the rest and a teammate checks them.

events.title: Antarctica Day 2021: painting and short comic story competition for school students
events.venue: Online (entries from school students across India)
events.summary: To mark Antarctica Day 2021 and Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, NCPOR ran a painting competition and a short comic story writing competition for school students. Painting themes were climate change in polar regions, pollution in oceans, and Antarctica as you imagine it. NCPOR later published a video of the students' paintings.
events.verify: The date is Antarctica Day (1 December). The source does not give the competition's own dates.

events.title: Antarctica Day 2023 and 40 years of Dakshin Gangotri
events.summary: NCPOR marked Antarctica Day together with the 40th anniversary of the commissioning of Dakshin Gangotri, India's first research station in Antarctica. The programme included a talk on Indian footprints in Antarctica, the release of the logo of the 46th Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting (Kochi), and the felicitation of members of India's first Antarctic expeditions.
events.verify: Venue assumed to be NCPOR, Goa (the recording is titled 'NCPOR Antarctica Day 2023'). Check in the video.

events.title: Flag-off of India's first winter scientific expedition to the Arctic
events.venue: Ministry of Earth Sciences headquarters, New Delhi
events.summary: The Union Minister of Earth Sciences flagged off India's first winter scientific expedition to the Arctic, bound for Himadri at Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard. Himadri, operated since 2008, had mostly hosted scientists in summer. Winter expeditions allow observations during the polar night.
events.source_name: PIB, Ministry of Earth Sciences, 18 Dec 2023

events.title: Call for research proposals: 44th Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica
events.summary: NCPOR invited long-term research proposals for the 44th Indian Scientific Expedition to Antarctica, themed 'Climate Change and its signatures in Antarctica', including the research area Geological Exploration of Amery Ice Shelf (GeoEAIS). Online submissions closed on 25 February 2024.

events.title: NCPOR 24th Foundation Day and opening of the Bharati Branch Post Office in Antarctica
events.venue: NCPOR, Goa, with Bharati Station, Antarctica, via web link
events.summary: On NCPOR's 24th Foundation Day, the Chief Postmaster General of the Maharashtra Circle opened the Bharati Branch Post Office at Bharati Station through a web link, and a picture postcard of Bharati was released. It is the third post office India has set up in Antarctica, after Dakshin Gangotri (1984) and Maitri (1990). The Foundation Day lecture, 'Planetary and Space Missions of India', was given by the Director of the Physical Research Laboratory, Ahmedabad.

events.title: 46th Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting (ATCM-46) and CEP-26, hosted by India
events.venue: Lulu Bolgatty International Convention Centre, Kochi, Kerala
events.summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences, through NCPOR, hosted the 46th Antarctic Treaty Consultative Meeting and the 26th meeting of the Committee for Environmental Protection, under the theme Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam. The parties adopted 17 revised and new management plans for Antarctic Specially Protected Areas. India announced its plan to set up a new research station, Maitri-II.
events.source_name: PIB, Ministry of Earth Sciences, 31 May 2024

events.title: NCPOR at the 38th COMNAP Annual General Meeting, Tromsø
events.summary: NCPOR represented India at the 38th Annual General Meeting of COMNAP, the council of national Antarctic programmes. An NCPOR scientist serving as a COMNAP Vice-Chair represented India in its leadership, and NCPOR scientists led the sessions on science facilitation and on critical technologies.

events.title: NCPOR at the 12th SCAR Open Science Conference, Oslo
events.summary: NCPOR researchers presented their work at the 12th SCAR Open Science Conference, themed 'Diving into Antarctic Science – Making Waves for the Future'. An NCPOR scientist co-convened two sessions, on Antarctic extreme events and on the atmosphere–ice–ocean boundary of the Southern Ocean, with 88 presentations between them.
events.verify: Dates are the main conference dates from SCAR's site; the NCPOR item does not give dates.

events.title: Independence Day 2026 at NCPOR
events.summary: NCPOR celebrated Independence Day with the National Song, the unfurling of the Tricolour by the Director and the National Anthem. In his address, the Director spoke about the institute's infrastructure advances and thanked its scientists, engineers, students and support staff.
events.verify: Institute-wide event; region set to antarctic like the annual reports.

events.title: India at the 39th SCAR Delegates Meeting, and renewal of the SCAR–IASC agreement
events.summary: The Director of NCPOR represented India at the 39th Delegates Meeting of the Scientific Committee on Antarctic Research. On 17 August, as Chair of the Asian Forum for Polar Sciences (AFoPS), he signed a renewed MoU with SCAR and the International Arctic Science Committee to strengthen joint research and shared use of polar infrastructure. SCAR, IASC and WMO will lead the 5th International Polar Year.

events.title: State-level Hindi essay writing competition at NCPOR (NARAKAS, South Goa)
events.title_hi: एनसीपीओआर में नराकास, दक्षिण गोवा के तत्वावधान में राज्यस्तरीय निबंध लेखन प्रतियोगिता
events.summary: Under the Nagar Rajbhasha Karyanvayan Samiti (NARAKAS), South Goa, NCPOR hosted a state-level Hindi essay competition for staff of central government offices, banks and autonomous bodies in Goa. About 65 participants from more than 40 institutions took part. The aim was to encourage the use of Hindi in everyday official work.
events.verify: title_hi is shortened from the Hindi heading of the source; check it reads well. The essay topic is given in Hindi in the source; copy it exactly if you show it.

events.title: Senior naval officers of the Advanced Hydrography Course visit NCPOR
events.summary: NCPOR hosted senior naval officers from the Advanced Hydrography Course. NCPOR scientists presented India's presence in the polar regions and the institute's work in deep-ocean exploration and mapping.

events.title: Workshop: Southern Ocean Biogeochemistry – Future Directions and Way Forward
events.summary: A day-long workshop and brainstorming meeting brought together scientists to plan short- and long-term biogeochemistry research in the Indian sector of the Southern Ocean. It closed with a list of scientific gaps, research priorities and observation needs.

events.title: Launch of India's new ocean research vessel 'Sagar Manthan'
events.summary: The Minister of Earth Sciences launched the ocean research vessel Sagar Manthan, built by Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers under the Deep Ocean Mission with NCPOR as the nodal agency. After fitting-out and sea trials, delivery to NCPOR is planned for 2028. The vessel is equipped for seafloor mapping, marine geology and geophysics, mineral exploration and biodiversity studies.
events.verify: The date (9 Sep 2026) comes from press coverage; the NCPOR item does not state it. The region is a best fit: the vessel is for ocean research generally.

events.title: Swachh Sagar, Surakshit Sagar pledge at NCPOR and at Himadri
events.venue: NCPOR, Goa, and Himadri, Ny-Ålesund, Svalbard
events.summary: As part of Swachh Sagar, Surakshit Sagar 5.0, NCPOR staff took the clean-ocean pledge. Members of the 17th Indian Arctic Expedition (2026–27) took the same pledge at Himadri, India's Arctic research station.
events.verify: The source says the NCPOR pledge was on 9 September; it does not date the pledge at Himadri. ARCTIC-17 is a new expedition code to add (see CHECKLIST.md).

events.title: Asian Forum for Polar Sciences (AFoPS) annual meeting opens in Kochi
events.summary: The Annual General Meeting of the Asian Forum for Polar Sciences began in Kochi, with welcome remarks by the NCPOR Director as AFoPS Chair. Delegations from China, India, Japan, Korea, Malaysia, Thailand and the UAE presented national reports.
events.verify: End date not given in the source.

events.title: Beach clean-up at Miramar, Goa: Swachh Sagar, Surakshit Sagar 5.0
events.summary: NCPOR volunteers joined a nationwide beach clean-up at Miramar Beach in the presence of the Governor of Goa. The waste collected, including plastics, glass bottles and fishing-net fragments, was segregated for responsible disposal.
events.verify: Region is a best fit (coastal outreach); there is no polar region for it.
